description.zh: ? 一句话：按文档讲的是什么来找，不用记得原词。用你选的模型（本机的 Ollama，或云服务的密钥）
description.en: ? a sentence: finds documents by what they are about, not by their words. Uses the model you pick (Ollama on this PC, or a cloud service's key)

description.zh: 描述你要找的文档，按意思找出来
description.en: Describe the document you want; it is found by meaning

hint.zh: 一句话描述文件，例如：去年报销的规定
hint.en: describe the file, e.g. last year's travel expense rules

ai.description: Find the user's documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, notes) by meaning, with the semantic index the user built: describe what the document is about in a sentence, in any language. Each item is a file (path) with the passage that matched best. Use it when search_content finds nothing because the user does not remember the exact words.

title.zh: 其他 OpenAI 兼容接口

hint.zh: 云服务要填；本机的 Ollama、LM Studio 不用。存在 Windows 凭据管理器里
hint.en: For cloud services; not for Ollama or LM Studio. Kept in Windows Credential Manager

hint.zh: 留空用推荐的：Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b，硅基流动 BAAI/bge-m3，百炼 text-embedding-v4，OpenAI text-embedding-3-small
hint.en: Empty for the recommended one: Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b, SiliconFlow BAAI/bge-m3, Model Studio text-embedding-v4, OpenAI text-embedding-3-small

hint.zh: 留空用服务的默认地址；其他接口填到 /v1 为止
hint.en: Empty for the service's own; for another API, up to /v1

hint.zh: 用分号隔开，例如 %USERPROFILE%\Documents;D:\工作。留空是内容索引里的全部（系统和程序文件夹除外）
hint.en: Separated by semicolons, e.g. %USERPROFILE%\Documents;D:\Work. Empty: all of the content index (but system and program folders)

title.zh: 文档和笔记（再加 txt、md；代码项目里的说明文件也会算进来）
title.en: Documents and notes (and txt, md; READMEs of code projects count too)
